primer_basis: Explicit 5 g/m2 per face planning allowance from 028b; no matched dry density/uptake/Be process.
NiCr_density_basis: 8400 kg/m3 planning proxy; tiny tie-layer term separately identified.
water_basis: AF fraction is largest historical 2U WVR, not equilibrium absorption; core/primer/seams/oxide/PSA are planning values, not measurements.

routes.definition: Dry-gas assembly alone: no credit for removing initial material water.
70 C preseal vacuum conditioning to an assumed gravimetric 90% removal endpoint; no fixed bake duration inferred.
Onboard capture leaves total water aboard; add bed and cartridge outside the reserved 100 kg.

notes: Water removal is not a reduction of the external retained-liquid layer.
No nominal adhesive TML mass is subtracted; 040 volatile inventory remains as a pressure bound.
All geometry, mechanical, weather, joining, gas, pad and systems equations otherwise reuse 040.
